entities.name: Unified Access Control
entities.description: Procedure for controlling UE access to the network based on access categories and barring parameters.

entities.name: Access Category
entities.description: Category defining the type of access attempt (e.g., emergency, mobile originated signaling, data).

entities.name: Barring Parameters
entities.description: Network-configured parameters that determine if access is barred for specific categories.

entities.name: UE Access Attempt
entities.description: UE-initiated attempt to access the network, subject to unified access control checks.

relations.description: Unified Access Control procedure uses access categories to determine barring.
Unified Access Control procedure applies barring parameters to control access.
UE access attempt triggers the Unified Access Control procedure.
